headline: Vision-RL2 reports fine-grained visual accuracy gains with a small region predictor
summary: Vision-RL2 trains a small region proposal network with region-level reinforcement learning to identify evidence regions for a frozen multimodal reader, then encodes those regions sparsely. The authors report improved accuracy over base systems across six fine-grained benchmarks and four backbones. In a separate training-aligned protocol, the Qwen3.5-4B system at a 576-token source limit reports a six-benchmark average of 71.1, versus 66.6 for SD-RPN, and matches SD-RPN at a 4,096-token limit with 4.2 times fewer visual tokens. These remain paper-reported results; the evaluation protocols differ and performance trades off on some MME-RealWorld splits.
